# Sentinel — documentation index

Sentinel detects phishing and malicious websites through threat analysis, web security assessment, certificate validation, and collaborative threat intelligence.

## Repository documents
- PRD.md — product requirements: target user, core user flow, acceptance checks, non-goals
- DESIGN.md — visual design system & tokens (YAML) and anti-slop prose rules
- AGENTS.md — cross-agent rules: build/test commands, directory structure, component allow-list
- CLAUDE.md — persistent tool context (imports AGENTS.md)
- docs/architecture.md — system boundaries, modules, state, integrations
- docs/code-standards.md — reusable patterns and utilities
- context/progress.md — session memory: completed slices, active bugs, next steps

## Presentation layer (React + Vite frontend)
- client/src/App.jsx — root component
- client/src/components/Hero.jsx — hero section with threat scanner
- client/src/components/Pillars.jsx — four threat analysis pillars
- client/src/components/ScanResult.jsx — scan result with gauge & verdict
- client/src/components/ThreatFeed.jsx — collaborative threat feed
- client/src/components/TextLoop.jsx — animated wave ribbon
- client/src/components/CurvedInput.jsx — curved URL input
- client/src/components/Lightfall.jsx — animated page background
- client/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx — dark/light theme toggle
- client/src/components/Footer.jsx — footer
- client/src/main.jsx — React entry point
- client/src/App.css — global styles & design tokens

## Verification
- scripts/verify-all-backend.mjs — full backend verification
- scripts/security-tests.mjs — 72-check security regression suite
- scripts/gate-lint.mjs — gate ledger linter
- GATES.md — frontend completion ledger
- GATES.backend.md — backend completion ledger
